title: Yum Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
description_expanded: **SNOWBIRD PROMOTION- Save 50% PER NIGHT January and February for monthly stays!** HOME HILIGHTS: *This home adheres to the Watercolor Rental Advertising Policies and Guidelines:* *Maximum Certified Number of Guests for this home is 4 (2 adults and 1-2 children) *Up to 4 wristbands are included to access Watercolor’s 5 pools, including the Beach Club pool and Camp Watercolor, as well as access to the private beach. The wristbands are issued to registered guests that are staying at the home, and strictly limited by the home’s Maximum Certified Number of Guests. *This home has a private driveway and includes 1 Watercolor parking pass to use throughout Watercolor in designated locations - Short walk to the beach, community pools, shopping, and dining - 2 adult sized beach cruisers included - Fully stocked kitchen - Private beach with seasonal tram service - Sandpiper Linen Program Participant: All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality. OPTIONAL ADD-ON: **Optional Cancellation Protection**- Allows cancellation for ANY reason up to 48 hours in advance of stay and guarantees 50% of all monies paid returned ($50 fee applies at booking). YUM is a beautiful carriage house tucked away in WaterColor's Camp District with the state forestlands in your backyard and a short walk/bike ride to Watercolor's pools, lake, and Gulf. This beautifully appointed 1 bedroom lets you take in all that Watercolor has to offer: part home, part destination resort—the best of both worlds. Stay for a few nights or for a month, this carriage house has everything you need including a full kitchen and washer/dryer, separate KING bedroom and pull-out couch in the great room if needed for a little one or two. ACCOMMODATIONS: Bedroom 1: King bed, Flat screen TV Sleeper Sofa(living room) Hallway full bathroom with tub/shower combination IMPORTANT DETAILS: **Please note: This home does NOT have charging capabilities for a golf cart. **Detached main house is not for rent and reserved for owner use only* Free WiFi Must be 25 to rent Sorry, no pets!
